formula: Parcel bill reduction using the annual municipality/school-district rate and capped value base, subject to valid claim, parcel tax liability and installment rules.
application: Apply to the county or eligible city treasurer. A missing 2025 bill credit may be claimed through the municipal treasurer by January 31, 2026, or by late DOR application through October 1, 2026.

formula: The state allocates School Levy funding using each municipality’s share of three-year average school levies. Within the municipality, assessed value determines each parcel’s amount; net levy/tax figures already reflect that amount.
application: Applied through local property-tax billing, not income-tax return.
eligibility_notes: Applies to every taxable real-property parcel, including vacant, rental and commercial property; no primary-residence requirement. | This is property-owner bill relief, not a direct renter payment.

age_rule: No general age restriction.
income_definition: Total household income compared with the greater of county or state median household income.
income_limits: Up to 145% of applicable median income, with lower benefits above the 125% tier.
maximum_benefit: 75% of eligible taxes paid, limited to half the county median residential tax bill; upper income tier receives a 35% reduction.
formula: Income-tier refund using paid taxes, county median tax cap and asset/residency tests.
application: Annual application through Department of Revenue or official refund portal; supporting tax-payment and household-income records required.
eligibility_notes: Wyoming resident at least five years; primary residence. | For 2025, combined countable household assets must not exceed $169,866 times the number of adult household members, with program exclusions. | The asset test does not apply when the person's tax liability strictly exceeds 10% of household income; equality does not trigger the waiver.
program_year: 2025 property taxes, refund application in 2026.
state_research_notes: An exact refund calculation requires county median-income and median-tax-bill tables. | The 25% and 50% exemptions are not additive in 2025/26. | The statute and rules use an inclusive combined-adult asset limit with a tax-liability waiver. The form/portal's strict per-adult wording differs; the statute sets the inclusive combined-adult test. The waiver uses tax liability; the refund uses qualifying timely-paid tax. Household facts and county tables determine the applicable amount.
